headline: Executive order changes an earlier order that gives the Secretary of Commerce certain duties related to NOAA.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 11023, an older order that hands certain presidential duties to the Secretary of Commerce. Those duties relate to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), the agency that handles weather forecasting, ocean science, and related work. The title does not say exactly which duties were added or changed, so the specific effects are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Secretary of Commerce and NOAA officials
who_it_affects.how: Their assigned duties related to NOAA are adjusted, though the specific changes are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 20, 2004; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
